plan: Given my value of $25, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Assuming Betty and Charles bid close to their values, I will bid $24. This ensures a potential profit if I win, as I would pay the third-highest bid. If I bid too high, I risk overpaying relative to my value. If I bid too low, I risk losing the auction. I will not bid above my value to avoid a negative profit.

Given my private value of $3, I aim to bid conservatively since my value is low. Assuming others bid closer to their values, I expect their bids to be higher. I will bid $0.1 to avoid winning, as winning would likely result in a loss due to paying the third-highest bid, which could be near or above my value. This strategy minimizes potential losses and maximizes long-term profit by not winning an unprofitable auction.
